lines.text: Many learners say: I and my friend went there.
Better: My friend and I went there.
My brother and I! My brother and I went there.

data.wrong: I and my friend went there.
data.right: My friend and I went there.

native.hook: 说“我和朋友”要把 I 放后面！
native.tip: 中文说“我和朋友”，“我”在前面很自然。英语里把别人放前面更礼貌，要说 my friend and I。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “I and my friend went there.”😅 中文“我和朋友”，英语把 I 放后面：“My friend and I went there.”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“My friend and I went there.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: In Chinese “I and my friend” sounds natural, but English puts I last.
en.caption: Do you say “I and my friend went there.” 😅 English puts I last: “My friend and I went there.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
